narrative: 三人组自带政治关系。二对一、中间那个起枢纽作用的人、一个迟到者拆散了原本的一对——三角关系本身就是故事。
如果你只用乒乓球式的单人镜头来覆盖，观众永远看不到在真实空间里究竟是谁被排除在外。当整体是四人或更多人时，或者当场面已经收缩为一对时，三人镜头就不是合适的工具。
如果你把三个脑袋排成一排，光线均等、高度均等，然后就管这叫戏剧张力，那这也不是合适的工具。应该有人占据三角形的顶点，或者有人站在三角形的“寒冷地带”。
how: 把三个人安排成一个在纵深方向或横向画面上的三角形，而不是像警局排队指认那样一字排开——除非故事本身就是行刑队。三角形构图（Triangular Composition）会有帮助，但调度才是第一位的：座位、高低层次、谁面对谁。
让三个人的脸或姿态都保持足够可读，便于彼此比较。提示词：Three-shot of [Subject] in a triangular group, alliances and the odd one out readable in blocking.
when: 当三人组自带政治关系时使用它：三个持枪的人、三个等待判决的人、一对情侣加上一个不该出现在场的人。不要把他们拍成三张地位均等的肖像，也不要把三人镜头用在一群人身上。
vs: 双人镜头是一对；加入第三个人就改变了整个语法。群像镜头（Group Shot）容纳的是三人以上的小型群体，作为一个关系整体。
如果整场戏的全部动作都发生在这三个人身上，主镜头（Master Shot）也可以是一个三人镜头。不要把三人镜头当成“任何带着几个群众演员的全景镜头”的同义词。
examples_film: 《黄金三镖客》是教科书式的三人组：三个男人、三种距离、一个墓地般的构图逻辑。这场对峙之所以成立，是因为在切到眼睛特写之前，三个人在共享画面里始终保持着可比较的地位。
语法：三位主要人物，清晰可读的联盟关系。
mistakes: 最常被搞混的近邻是裁掉了第三人的双人镜头，或者两侧塞满群众演员的群像镜头。破绽是两张脸加一个肩膀，或者一群人。
解决办法：三位主要人物，三角形调度，让其中一人稍稍显得被排除在外。

faq.a: 三人镜头把三位主要人物放进同一个构图，让他们的联盟关系、调度，以及谁被排除在外都清晰可读。它不是三个特写排在一起。
双人镜头是一对，以及他们之间的空间。三人镜头加入了第三位主要人物，以及一套三角形的政治关系。如果第三个人只是一个虚焦的群众演员，那依然只是双人镜头。
当整场戏的力量结构是三方的时使用它：联盟、一个枢纽人物、一个被排除在外的人。不要把它用在一对人身上，也不要把它当成更大群体的替代品。

faq.q: How do I prompt Three-Shot for AI image or video?
faq.a: 写：Three-shot of [Subject] in a triangular group, alliances and the odd one out readable in blocking。点名谁被孤立。让三个人都保持可读。

narrative: A trio has politics. Two against one, a hinge person in the middle, a late arrival who splits a pair: the triangle is the story.

If you only cover this as ping-pong singles, the audience never sees who is left out in real space. It is the wrong tool when there are four or more as a unit, or when the scene has collapsed to a pair.
It is also the wrong tool if you line three heads up with equal light and equal height and call that drama. Someone should own a peak of the triangle, or stand in the cold of it.
how: Arrange three bodies as a triangle in depth or across the frame, not a flat police lineup unless the story is a firing squad. Triangular Composition helps, but blocking comes first: seats, levels, who faces whom.
Keep all three faces or postures readable enough to compare. Prompt: Three-shot of [Subject] in a triangular group, alliances and the odd one out readable in blocking.
when: Use it when a trio has politics: three gunmen, three people at a verdict, a couple plus the person who should not be there. Do not flatten them into equal portraits, and do not use a three-shot for a crowd.
vs: A Two-Shot is a pair; adding a third changes the grammar. A Group Shot holds a small ensemble larger than three as a relational unit.
A Master Shot may be a three-shot if the whole action is those three bodies. Do not treat three-shot as a synonym for any wide with extra extras.
examples_film: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly is the textbook trio: three men, three distances, one cemetery geometry. The standoff only works because all three remain comparable in shared frames before the eyes take over.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Two-Shot that crops the third, or a Group Shot with extras filling the sides. The tell is two faces and a shoulder, or a crowd.
Fix: three principals, triangular blocking, one of them slightly out.

faq.a: A three-shot frames three principal people in one composition so their alliances, blocking, and who is left out are readable. It is not three close-ups in a row.
A two-shot is a pair and the space between them. A three-shot adds a third principal and a triangle of politics. If the third person is only an out-of-focus extra, you still have a two-shot.
Use it when the scene's power is three-way: alliances, a hinge, an odd one out. Do not use it for a pair, and do not use it as a stand-in for a larger ensemble.

faq.q: How do I prompt Three-Shot for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write Three-shot of [Subject] in a triangular group, alliances and the odd one out readable in blocking. Name who is isolated. Keep all three readable.
